scenarios.name: Move a custom command into and out of the expanded panel

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target
the user confirms the customization
the 2D Sketches icon appears in the User Commands main panel
the user right-clicks that icon
its context menu offers Move to Expanded Panel
the user selects Move to Expanded Panel
the icon is absent from the main panel
the User Commands title offers an expansion control
the user opens the User Commands expansion
the 2D Sketches icon appears in the expanded area
the user right-clicks the expanded icon
the user selects Move to Main Panel
the expansion closes
the 2D Sketches icon returns to the main panel
the user reopens Customize from Tools
the user removes 2D Sketches from the Part Tools target
the user confirms the customization
the User Commands panel is removed
